description: Taking photos and videos is fun, but often the results can be dull, and boring. Download the LifeCam Dashboard, and suddenly your videos become very colorful ? and very interesting! With TrueColor Technology, you get bright and colorful video in virtually all lighting conditions. But when you add special effects to your videos, you uncover a fun and silly side of you, your family, and friends that you may never have seen before. This app requires a Microsoft LifeCam Studio, Cinema, HD-6000 for notebooks, HD-5000, HD-5001 or HD-3000.
